title: wg: METADATA pass-through in bouncers (soju, ZNC), the cheapest useful PR
description:
Mark, 2026-11-22. Separated from the identity-key proposal because it carries no identity opinion and so is far likelier to be accepted.

A bouncer sits between a client and a server; for the identity convention of mimid-i0id.11 to be usable through one, the bouncer need only relay METADATA and its numerics (761 RPL_KEYVALUE, 762 RPL_METADATAEND, 766 ERR_NOMATCHINGKEY) and the FAIL METADATA forms, in both directions, without interpreting them. Pure plumbing.

Targets, in order of likely acceptance: soju (Go, by emersion, who also wrote Goguma, which mimid's IRC v2 already targets, so there is an existing connection) and then ZNC.

Check first, per the peer-contributing-rules memory: each project's CONTRIBUTING and templates, and whether it already relays METADATA, which would make this a no-op. Nothing is posted without Mark's per-action OK.
